title: Full-charge range and charging expectations
summary: Reviews discuss desired full-charge driving range, displayed range, cold-weather range loss, charging time expectations, and hybrid-versus-EV usability without a clear sentiment assignment.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention requested higher full-charge range, displayed or expected battery range, cold-weather range limits, charging duration expectations, and preference for hybrid flexibility on longer trips.

limitations: All sampled fragments are labeled undetermined, so the topic can only be described as discussed rather than liked or disliked.

The examples mix several related subtopics—target range, observed range in cold weather, charge-time expectations, remote start at partial charge, and long-trip suitability—so a single consistent customer stance cannot be established.
Examples are insufficient to determine whether statements compare the G70 directly with competitors, express firm preferences, or simply note expectations.
